_about: RECORDED 2026-10-09 from the phone table sheet AS IT STOOD (after the Done fix, before its name, shape, Rotate · Edit chairs · Link and Delete moved onto the templates): the sheet was first moved WHOLE into `PhoneTableDock` (`seat-plan-phone.tsx`, markup unchanged, every handler handed in from the editor), then bundled with esbuild (handlers replaced by recorders) and driven in Chromium at 375 px. `calls` = which handler each press called and with what; `labels` = every button's name. Two differences on purpose: Esc on the name (the old box blurred and re-sent the SAME label — `renameTable` ignores an unchanged label — the row now sends nothing), and the name is a Form-row pill, so it is one more named button.
